verdict.rationale: Expensify's own spend-management page lists "Smart Limits on cards," a first-party card control that plausibly covers amount-based restrictions. Nothing in the pack shows restrictions by category or merchant, or explains how limits are enforced at the point of sale. Missing for 10: category-based card restrictions, merchant-based restrictions, documented auto-lock/decline of out-of-policy transactions at point of sale, details of how Smart Limits work, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
